def first_name_amount_at_least_25(lines):
    """Identify the first job ticket in a print shop's intake queue whose
    recorded amount clears the shop's long-standing batch threshold, and
    report the tag under which that ticket was filed.

    The Meridian Press operates a single intake counter at which every
    incoming order is transcribed onto a ticket before it is passed to
    the pressroom. At the close of each hour, the counter clerk hands
    the accumulated tickets, still in the order of their arrival, to
    the floor supervisor, who must determine which order, if any, is
    substantial enough to warrant opening the large-format press for a
    dedicated batch run. Shop policy has long fixed the qualifying
    figure for such a run at twenty-five units, and the present
    function serves as the clerical instrument by which the supervisor
    renders this determination.

    The hour's queue is presented to the function as the argument
    lines. Each element of lines is a list of exactly three values: a
    tag (str), a amount (int), and a weight (int). The tag is the
    short label the counter clerk pencils onto the ticket so that the
    order may be identified on the floor; the amount records how many
    copies the customer has requested; the weight notes the paper
    stock assigned to the job, and is carried on the ticket for the
    pressroom's own reference.

    The supervisor reads the tickets precisely as the clerk stacked
    them, from the earliest arrival onward, and settles upon the first
    ticket that satisfies the threshold. Scan the lines in order and
    return the tag of the first one whose amount is greater than or
    equal to 25; return None when none qualifies. Once a qualifying
    ticket has been identified, the tickets behind it in the stack
    hold no further interest for this determination; and on a quiet
    hour, when the stack contains no ticket of sufficient size, or
    indeed no tickets at all, the record is to show that no batch run
    was warranted.

    The examples below illustrate the expected conduct of the function
    upon three representative stacks of tickets.

    >>> first_name_amount_at_least_25([['Ana', 25, 5]])
    'Ana'
    >>> first_name_amount_at_least_25([['error', 30, 15], ['Dee', 11, 13], ['widget', 18, 0], ['Cy', 33, 18], ['Ana', 27, 21]])
    'error'
    >>> first_name_amount_at_least_25([])
    """
